article.title: Reflexivo directo
article.chapter: Verbos en -ся: reflexividad, medio y pasiva — Глаголы на -ся

claims.summary: The direct reflexive can be expressed with a verb in -ся when agent/subject and patient are correlative.
The explanation of how reflexive verbs work in Russian, including the absorption of the direct object by the verb suffix -ся.
Examples illustrating the use of reflexive verbs in Russian, including 'Он умывается каждое утро' and 'Она причёсывается перед зеркалом'.

links.notes: The article explicitly states that the direct reflexive can be expressed with a verb in -ся when the agent/speaker and patient are the same, as demonstrated in examples like 'Он умывается' meaning 'He washes himself'.
